\chapter{Hashing \& Counting}
\label{ch:hashing}

\begin{tcolorbox}[enhanced, colback=white, colframe=secondaryblue, boxrule=1pt, arc=2mm]
\textbf{\large\textcolor{primaryblue}{Trade memory for time: a hash map remembers what you have seen, so the second loop of a pair search disappears.}}
\end{tcolorbox}

\chapterfacts{900}{1700}{5}{10}{30}

\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=*, label=\textbf{A\arabic*.}, itemsep=1pt]
    \item Hash sets and hash maps: expected $\bigO{1}$, collisions, \texttt{unordered\_map} versus \texttt{map} versus a plain array
